content.value: Combat grants Player XP. Active fighters, tanks and party support can qualify for eligible hostile-enemy rewards. Passive animals, players, automated kills and creatures from ordinary or trial spawners do not grant combat XP.

Each new highest Player Level grants one Passive Tree point. The default next-level requirement is floor(50 + 5 × current level + 0.2 × current level²), with a level cap of 90. The inventory stats panel shows your current progress.

Eligible nearby members share 120% of the solo XP pool with two participants and 140% with three, increasing to 200% with six or more. Each individual receives less than a solo kill, while the group earns more in total. Contribute to the encounter rather than simply standing nearby.

First discoveries of meaningful resources, recipes, biomes and generated structures reward World XP. First taming, breeding and fish-catching discoveries also contribute. Each discovery belongs to the player and pays once. Repeating the same harvest, craft or failed experiment does not produce another discovery reward.

Both levels, discovery records and earned tree points remain. Without keepInventory, death removes 30 percentage points from the current combat XP bar, down to a minimum of zero. World XP remains. With keepInventory, combat XP is retained too.
